periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Vertical orientation with a slight anterior tilt of approximately 15 degrees toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated elliptical shape with a visual width-to-height ratio of approximately 1:2.2.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: A distinct downward tapering effect is visible at the lower pole of the eye patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Flat U-shaped profile along the posterior boundary of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band constitutes approximately 40-45% of the visible vertical height of the lateral torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, uninterrupted semicircular curvature at the apex of the visible pinna.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark-pigmented claws on the right forepaw and matted or clumped fur texture on the head and neck.
